title: Blue & Silver Baby Shower
description: A blue sequin backdrop framed on both sides by an organic garland stepping from navy through ice blue to chrome. The table beneath is staged for arrivals — gift bags lined up, favours boxed, and a printed sign at the centre.

alt.blue-silver-arch-gift-table.jpg: A blue sequin backdrop framed by a navy, ice blue, and chrome balloon garland, above a gift table lined with favour bags
